title: Agency operating policy
lead: Record actual coverage, service hours and policy references. Save a draft, review its effects, then approve the exact version.
none: No reviewed policy is recorded. Unknown policy keeps the affected action on hold.
calendarHelp: Sofia local time. Choose unknown, closed or staffed for each day. A reviewed calendar is valid only within the recorded bounds.
rangesHelp: HH:mm-HH:mm; separate intervals with a comma. Use 24:00 for an interval ending at midnight. Overnight work needs a separate interval on each day.
exceptionsHelp: One line per exception: YYYY-MM-DD | HH:mm-HH:mm | reason. Use — for closed or ? for unknown. Exceptions replace that day’s weekly hours.
referencesHelp: Record approved source references, not invented terms or legal periods. These references do not approve a vendor, enroll a customer or enable sending.
controlsHelp: Reviewed intervals shorten the existing 14-day sale and 7-day long-term rental baseline for a new human confirmation only. An unknown interval holds the new confirmation. Recorded deadlines remain unchanged. Existing alert and privacy controls still check their own permissions and conditions.
effectsHelp: New work records the approved version. Existing accepted work keeps its original policy context. A recorded source does not establish production readiness or a public response guarantee.
ready: Policy recorded; action still checks its own permissions and conditions
held: Held — policy is incomplete or unknown
reviewed: I reviewed this exact draft, its sources, named responsibilities and effects. Unknown values remain held.
savedNext: Review the saved draft and its effects before approval.
approvedNext: The approved version applies to new work. Earlier commitments retain their recorded context.
invalid: Review the entered values and required calendar sources.
conflict: The policy changed. Your draft is retained; compare it with the current policy before submitting again.
failed: The change was not applied. Review current permission, authentication and policy state.
stepUp: Confirm your identity, then review and submit this approval again.
pending: The result is unknown. Check this operation before trying again.
noReceipt: No completed operation is recorded for this request. Review the policy before another submission.

fields.coverage: Approved areas, property types and services

reviewHeld: Availability confirmation is held because current policy has no reviewed interval for this listing purpose. Ask the agency policy owner to review it.
ownerSearchHelp: Search active staff by name. Browsing keeps the entered policy values and does not save or approve them.
ownerResults: Choose from the matching staff below
ownerNone: No active staff match this page
ownerInvalid: Use a name of at most 120 characters and a valid staff page.
